svm.note: UPGRADEABLE, deliberately. v1 was finalised and then had to be replaced at a new program id to fix the empty-delivery rent bug, which is the cost of finalising while review is still in progress. This one stays upgradeable until that review is done. Finalise with `solana program set-upgrade-authority --final` (irreversible). Note the ProgramData account is allocated at exactly the program length, so a larger future build needs `solana program extend` first.

superseded.note: v1. Both are still live and still work; neither can be changed - the EVM contract has no upgrade path and the Solana program was finalised. They issue a transfer even when they hold nothing, which burns gas on EVM, reverts on ERC-20s that reject zero-value transfers, and on Solana allocates the recipient ATA anyway - charging the caller 2039280 lamports of unrecoverable rent to deliver nothing. Do not point new integrations at these; if you already do, never call them with min == 0.
